description: Per-host network access control using firewalld zones or nftables rules. Restricts which network sources can reach specific services, reducing attack surface.

cvss_vector_impacts.rationale: Service only reachable from adjacent/authorized networks
Firewall prevents lateral movement to other services

verification.method: Verify firewalld is running with restrictive zone

steps.description: Enable and start firewalld if not already running
Set the default zone to drop (deny all inbound by default, only explicitly allowed services/ports are reachable)
Allow SSH from a specific management network only (replace <mgmt_cidr> with your admin network, e.g., 10.0.1.0/24)
steps.command: firewall-cmd --permanent --zone=drop --add-rich-rule='rule family=ipv4 source address=<mgmt_cidr> service name=ssh accept'
steps.undo: firewall-cmd --permanent --zone=drop --remove-rich-rule='rule family=ipv4 source address=<mgmt_cidr> service name=ssh accept'

steps.description: Allow a specific application service port from authorized client networks only (replace <service_port> and <client_cidr>)
steps.command: firewall-cmd --permanent --zone=drop --add-rich-rule='rule family=ipv4 source address=<client_cidr> port port=<service_port> protocol=tcp accept'
steps.undo: firewall-cmd --permanent --zone=drop --remove-rich-rule='rule family=ipv4 source address=<client_cidr> port port=<service_port> protocol=tcp accept'

steps.description: Reload firewalld to apply permanent rules

references.source: RHEL 9 Security Hardening — Controlling network traffic using firewalld

remediation.name: nftables default-deny ruleset with per-service allowlisting

steps.description: Create a default-deny nftables ruleset file that allows established connections, ICMP, loopback, SSH from a management network, and a specific service port from authorized clients (replace <mgmt_cidr>, <client_cidr>, <service_port>)
Include the CME-202 ruleset from the main nftables config if not already included
Load the ruleset into the running kernel
Enable the nftables service so rules persist across reboots

references.source: nftables wiki — Simple ruleset for a server
